# op: # ARM64 unit containers only (called from arm-manifest.tsv after armobject, under fact:unit_container): armobject
# refuses hostaddr (EMIT.61 -> FAIL) because an ELF object cannot carry a host-slot relocation; a unit container
# discards the encoded text (UC.decode) and keeps only the tape, whose .hostaddr the image route resolves, so the
# generic hostaddr emitter armobject moved to AO.original.EMIT.61 is restored and the FAIL is moved aside.
# The restored emitter addresses a host FFI slot ([2^32-32, 2^32), e.g. the osx dl bridge); armobject's
# AO.textsection refuses that range (FAIL) because an ELF object has no form for it. In a unit container the
# ADRP/ADD placeholder and its relocation record are discarded, so the range is classified like text.
